channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Fed meeting live updates: Chairman Warsh says inflation is still too high
item.description: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point.

item.title: Fed approves interest rate hike, signals one more to come this year
item.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday approved its first interest rate hike since 2023 and indicated another to come.

item.title: House votes to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein subpoenas defiance
item.description: Billionaire Leon Black is suing the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee seeking to block subpoenas it issued him in its probe of Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Dow falls 400 points after Fed hikes rates and Warsh says inflation still too high: Live updates
item.description: Traders brace for the possibility of a new rate hiking cycle from the Federal Reserve.

item.title: Anthropic policy chief says AI companies can't be expected to operate on 'honor code'
item.description: Sarah Heck, Anthropic's head of public policy, offered her perspectives on AI safety as the debate about how to regulate model development intensifies.

item.title: Hegseth avoids impeachment vote with early House election recess
item.description: The House won't take a vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth after House leaders decided to leave Washington a day earlier than planned.

item.title: Intel is leading chip gains. A top analyst sees the stock hitting $200 in two years
item.description: Intel could hit as much as $200 per share in two years as it continues to strike lucrative deals with top chipmakers, per Melius Research.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield hovers at 4.98% as Fed hikes, Warsh highlights inflation risks
item.description: The 10-year Treasury note yield traded near the key 5% mark after a Federal Reserve rate increase and comments from Chairman Kevin Warsh highlighting persistent inflation risks.

item.title: Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household
item.description: Rising oil prices and Treasury yields are lifting energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households, pushing consumers to draw more heavily on savings.

item.title: Living abroad doesn't end your U.S. tax obligations. What young expats need to know
item.description: Americans living overseas may still face U.S. tax-filing and foreign-account reporting rules — even when they ultimately owe no U.S. income tax.

item.title: Hyperscaler debt signals warning sign, Apollo cautions
item.description: Credit default swaps for companies building data centers are getting pricier, and it's not because banks are hedging more of their bets.

item.title: 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices
item.description: Prices for diesel, the fuel type used to power trucks and trains, came in at an all-time high of $6.31 per gallon on Wednesday.

item.title: Continental Resources to develop massive oil patch in Venezuela
item.description: Continental said it undertook an "independent evaluation of opportunities" in Venezuela after President Donald Trump called for the industry to invest.

item.title: Sen. Blumenthal urges AI oversight: 'We're on the verge of losing control'
item.description: The Trump administration argues that beating China in the race to AI dominance is an all-important goal.

item.title: American Airlines says 30% of seats drive half of revenue as premium cabin rush heats up
item.description: American says a minority of its seats now accounts for half of its revenue.

item.title: World's top-performing sovereign wealth fund warns of looming pullback in U.S. stock market
item.description: New Zealand's $54 billion pension fund returned 14.2% in the year to June.

item.title: Pentagon CTO says U.S. government shouldn't take stakes in tech giants, questions adding AI rules
item.description: President Donald Trump has angrily pushed back on the calls from industry and lawmakers for an AI slowdown or greater regulation.

item.title: Lagging sector looks poised for a rebound. Here's how Mike Khouw is trading it
item.description: Quietly, the communications sector has started to claw back some of the year's underperformance.

item.description: Here are some of the companies making headlines in midday trading.

item.description: Frank Cappelleri of CappThesis breaks down the technicals on this name.

item.description: We're selling half of our remaining position and downgrading the name to our sell-on-further-strength 3 rating.

item.title: Higher rates can be good news for savers — but the best place for your cash depends on when you’ll need it
item.description: High-yield savings accounts and CDs both help your cash earn more interest, but each work best for different savings timelines.

item.title: House set to pass sweeping Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham
item.description: The Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill is on a path to become law after the House votes in favor.

item.title: OpenAI investors have approached the company about a new funding round
item.description: OpenAI is gearing up for what is widely expected to be a blockbuster IPO next year, after it confidentially filed its prospectus in June.

item.title: J.B. Hunt stock plunges 10% after company warns third-quarter earnings will fall
item.description: Shares of J.B. Hunt plunged more than 10% Wednesday after the company warned of an earnings drop between 5% and 10%.

item.title: Bizarre volatility bet in the options pits is a head scratcher ahead of Fed rate decision
item.description: The biggest trade in options on the Cboe VIX Index Tuesday was an unusual $6 million purchase of deep, deep in-the-money-puts.

item.title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
item.description: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

item.title: Amazon raises minimum hourly pay by $1 to $20 for operations workers
item.description: Amazon is raising the minimum wage for full-time operations workers in the U.S. to $20 per hour.

item.title: Costco expands Uber Eats delivery partnership to 47 states
item.description: Uber and Costco announced an expansion of a partnership where Costco members can order delivery from the store on Uber Eats to 47 states, up from 17.

item.title: Anthropic, OpenAI proposed new 'neutral' AI watchdogs. Why you should worry about the idea
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI are proposing embedded AI evaluators to help manage risk of models causing catastrophic harm to society, but the idea has some issues.
